scope: Frozen production Chromium/Metal. One God-menu belfry establishment per mode, then only actual W body movement through service bays, spiral mouths, crossing walk, north triforium, lower spiral and nave. Local compiled FP/props select a path; every runtime step is checked and ordinary input must traverse it. No warps after start, renderer substitutions, module mocks or screenshot stand-ins. Normal and reduced motion. Waypoint arrival accepts <=.505m on the same floor. Excludes earned route access and combat/ending acceptance. Screenshot filesystem errors are reported separately and do not cancel behavior checks; a null capture path is not visual evidence.
